controls: Historical approvals, note bytes, transcript references and verification reports remain unchanged after a rule-version change.
Current rules are re-evaluated against the exact saved source transcript for historical notes.
New exports are blocked when a post-change safety recheck finds a critical issue.
Previously generated exports are quarantined from download by a current-rule recheck; immutable stored export bytes are not rewritten or deleted.
The regression test simulates an old unsafe approval and export, then confirms workspace recheck blocks and download returns current_safety_review_required.

limitations: Rule-change quarantine depends on maintaining and incrementing RULES_VERSION when material safety rules change.
Quarantined artifacts remain stored as immutable historical records; download is blocked until the appropriate clinician workflow creates a current safe note/export.
CI synthetic fixtures do not establish independent clinical validation or authorize release.
